rule_before_measurement: Two new confirm cohorts, format order [22,16,42] then [42,16,22], same frozen EXE/environment/blobs and actual default profiling-enabled queue. All 48 cells per cohort, including negative controls; no selective reruns. 64 warmups, 8 ABBA cycles, 128 chains per arm, batch8. Both endpoint drifts <=3%; >=6 stable cycles and median stable throughput gain >=3%. Normal NRMSE<=5%,cosine>=0.995;outlier NRMSE<=10%,cosine>=0.98;max_abs recorded only. Retain only original 21 cells passing BOTH new cohorts; do not expand accepted set. Full device-resident chain includes raw decode, quantization, repack, both GEMMs, scaling and SwiGLU; no persistent INT8 weight cache or PCIe transfer. Normal process priority throughout. No whole-model speed/quality claim; not adopted.
hardware: Intel Arc A770 16GB, E5-2696 v4, PCIe 3.0 x16
